def VTask.greatestOfBdd (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ b) (Hineh : ∃ z, P z) : { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ ub } := by
  have h_main : ∃ (ub : ℤ), P ub ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → z ≤ ub := by
    classical
    -- Use the lemma `Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd` to find the greatest element
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := Hineh
    have h₁ : ∃ (z : ℤ), P z := ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩
    have h₂ : BddAbove {z : ℤ | P z} := by
      use b
      rintro z hz
      exact Hb z hz
    -- Apply `Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd` to get the greatest element
    obtain ⟨ub, hub, hub'⟩ := Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨ub, hub, fun z hz => hub' hz⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ub, hub₁, hub₂⟩ := h_main
  exact ⟨ub, hub₁, hub₂⟩
